- Full result JSON and configurable delta-trace JSON
- Success/error exit codes and artifact writing behavior implemented
- Exact release build verified:

```bash
cargo build --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml
```

Primary entry point: [main.rs](/workspace/output/src/main.rs)  
Execution engine: [executor.rs](/workspace/output/src/executor.rs)
